integrity: Analytical scalar reduction and Jacobian proof; standalone symbolic/exact/numerical checks supplement but do not replace proof. Neither independent audit nor independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification for the displayed deterministic node-wise pure-triad SIS ODE on friendship graphs only; no claim on stochastic finite-population behavior, global attractors, or nonlinear stability of folds. Literature coverage is bounded.
title: Equilibrium proliferation and sharp stability thresholds in pure-triad SIS contagion on friendship graphs
